diagnostics.message: this pairing edge's `why` carries the dietary-restriction marker "gluten". a pairing edge's authored rationale may not state an allergen or dietary reason. The renderer does not quote `why` today, so this edge is inert — which is exactly why it is cheap to reject now, one product decision before somebody makes the reason customer-facing. Forbidden by the ratified BKL-143 / BKL-123 / BKL-171 rulings, whose standing policy is honest self-report plus a real staff handoff; reopening requires an explicit owner reversal in writing. If this is an ordinary product whose NAME merely contains an ingredient word, that is the deliberate false positive documented in `src/pairing-graph.ts` — the product stays orderable and answerable by every other read, it just cannot be the subject of an automated suggestion.
